ABOUT THE MAJOR

The Business Administration major prepares students for careers in accounting, business, administration and nonprofit and church-related agencies. Students complete a set of foundational and advanced courses and an emphasis in a specific area - accounting, software development, marketing or management. 


MARKETING CAPSTONE AND MAJOR ELECTIVES

In addition to the courses listed below, students will also complete additional units of capstone courses, including an internship. To reach the total number of units required for graduation, students may need to complete additional Business electives. See catalog page for details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
